reviews.comment: I'm not sure why she doesn't have a 5/5, I loved her and this course! Attendance is mandatory for discussion points, but her lectures are very easy to sit through and understand. I learned a lot from this course simply because she did not try to to make it overly difficult and everything was very straightforward as long as you memorize material.

Dr. Hopkins is SO CARING. She loves her students and wants them to do well. That being said, she has to see you put work in too. She assigns a lot of work, but is an easy grader, so it evens out. I would recommend taking her if you don't mind the work being time consuming, but not "hard".

Online textbook with easy completion homework based on the textbook. Just grind the homework problems to study for the tests because test questions will be a little harder but very similar. Attendance is taken and lectures pretty much go over textbook material so pay attention if you want.
Online due to covid did not curve anything the extra credit was a waste of time. Very boring. Exams are very specific hard to study.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: No real complaints. Taken online during covid. Online modules require substantial time commitment if you want full credit. As long as you study the exams aren't that bad

She is a very caring professor. There were weekly discussions and homework assignments I didn't find too bad. She only had 3 exams (no final) and provided a study guide for each. Reading the textbook and answering the study guide was the best way study. Her recorded lectures didn't really provide any additional info.

The tests come from the textbook. If you want to pass, you don't need to hear the lectures, just memorize every story from the textbook. The teacher didn't add any content in her lectures. The slides are pre-made. There are small assignments each week but before tests people usually cram because five chapters of the textbook are tested at a time.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was actually harder than I thought it would be. Studied for each exam in advanced and got B's on 2/3 of them. Only way I got an A was because I went to every lecture and did the online homework.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Hopkins is a really great professor. She a very fair grader and is willing to meet outside of class if you have questions or concerns about a test or assignment. If a class does poorly on a test she is willing to curve. She also does participation points which are really easy to learn if you show up to lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors I have had at TAMU! So nice and really cares about her students learning. She makes the lectures interesting and gives good personal anecdotes from her field work. You will do group activities in class so participation matters. She also gives you really good study guides for the tests.

Very nice lady. Attendance is not mandatory. However, she grades you on participation as well. There are easy homework assignments that go off of the reading online, and the tests were taken online on campus with her. The tests were relatively easy if you fill out the review that she posts to ecampus. The material can be boring, but easy A for me.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's nice. Her class is easy. Just show up. Participate in discussions every once in a while. Read the textbook, do the assignments, take the test. It's easy.

Class is optional but participation points are randomly given which helps at the end of the semester because 2 of your lowest grades will be dropped. There is also homework and it is all very easy and the one page writings are graded by the students anonymously during class which ensures a passing grade.

Her lectures are based entirely off the slides, and attendance is not mandatory, but she does take random participation grades which at the end of the year will get your 2 lowest grades dropped. Apart from that, the class itself is interesting and the exams are easy if you read and do the Learnsmart homework. She also gives study guides for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: This class was difficult, but I really enjoyed having Dr. Hopkins as a professor. She definitely cares about you and wants you to learn. You can tell she is very passionate about her field. The class is pretty lecture heavy & can be boring at times, so I wouldn't take this class if you are not willing to go to class. Solid choice!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
